item.title: HARDMEIER and MORET retain titles at Swiss National Championships - European table tennis union
item.description: Elias HARDMEIER and Rachel MORET claimed the singles titles at the Swiss National Championships in Tenero. item.description: Kristijan STANOJKOVSKI and Amelia NIKOLOV claimed the singles titles at the National Closed Championships of North Macedonia, held in Skopje on 21-22 March.
